title: Raise conditional κ to 0.00312418633064 with a fourth accumulated update
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Conditional **κ = 0.00312418633064**, an increase of **0.00000082576064** over #5802 and **0.00000078633064** over concurrent #5806. The exact raw crossing is `(0.00312418633663374, 0.00312418633663375)`.

This realizes the released fourth, role-92 accumulation after composing #5802's three updates with both #5795 blocks. Six actual observations enter one owned buffer, which receives a paid native conversion, delivers before the next destination read and is cleared. Exact remapping handles a source chart node split into two. The additional signed gain is `H1 + H4 − H5`; changed helper targets and boundaries remain charged. The final word has 25,984 events and 799 coordinates; the complete caller pays 66,888 calls for 13,444 productive targets, with rank surplus 760.

All five framework assumptions remain: `native_all_columns`, `owned_erasure`, `compiler`, `precision_tape`, `analytic_recovery`. No large uniform word or rounded multiplier is materialized; no selected-frontier change or independent human acceptance is claimed.

## Task and overlap

Explicit donor assignment to improve κ; `p104-side-correction`, recorded changed scope, priority 8, base `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19205555).

Exact parents: #5802 `9bab1ca917ec4d1a4e60f4eb8c81d7ef92908a62` and #5795 `206cb717c0c07737d61637b93f7502ca48850348`. Dugongue's #5806 at `20e7289b63d240715aa96006571ae38a46291d97` concurrently proves the baseline join informally at κ≥0.0031234 without materializing it. That join is credited shared work; the fourth accumulation's exact realization and complete validation are additional here. Active mixed-payload searches are outside scope.

## Validation

Full normal and isolated/optimized registered replays pass, including all 638,401 endpoint coefficients, 2,919 native maps with absolute phase, the complete physical caller, two rational price engines, the compiler and all 54 strict/four functional outer checks. Thirty construction/caller/invoice controls, eleven source controls and four independent receipt controls reject corruptions. The final read-only, Git-free export passes with unchanged bytes/modes. Python 3.12.14, standard library only; exact commands and export hashes are in `VALIDATION.md`.

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-accumulated-block-composition
```

The complete budget, source bindings, proof and limitations are in `research/p104-accumulated-block-composition/`. Retained source bytes are pinned to our own ancestor commit; no pending-PR fetch is required. Hosted CI and independent scientific acceptance are separate.

## Credit

Ali Romman supplied the accumulation mechanism, provisional role-92 plan, second block and integration lineage; Joel Pulikkan/GamingPuzzled supplied R22; Dugongue supplied the concurrent baseline composition proof. All predecessor notices remain. New realization, compatibility and complete repricing: Mason Hale with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate implementation and checking agents. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

A separate reviewer can check the observation remapping, read barrier and all changed native/caller/compiler charges. Further κ improvements require a changed complete invoice and a fresh live-scope check; this fixed-invoice ceiling is not global. See the package README's next questions.

CI dependency: includes Ali Romman’s test-only repair from PR #5761, commit `ba8a9e640e1983f3c29993fefa3f46e8ed03313a`, cherry-picked with original authorship and provenance retained. Priority revision 8 changed the live catalogue, leaving the old onboarding tests with eight failures and two errors before package replay. The repair retains explicit historical-route fixtures and checks the live catalogue separately. Research artifacts, source pins and mathematical claims are unchanged by this repair.

Repair validation: the full `test_research_*.py` suite passes locally under Python 3.12.14 (513 tests, 29 platform-dependent skips), and all 12 routing tests pass in isolated optimized mode. Hosted plan and scientific replay both pass on repaired head `33d7760d0a6fea6394aefd014eea68f0af02a92e`: [successful run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40429519816).
